def solve(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    g=tuple(map(tuple,grid))
    allobjs=sorted(objects(g,True,False,True), key=lambda o: ulcorner(o))
    def norm(o):

    # pair by closest size (optimal assignment over 2x2)
    import itertools
    best=None
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(len(R))):
        d=sum(abs(size(L[k])-size(R[perm[k]])) for k in range(len(L)))
        if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,perm)
    perm=best[1]
    pairs=[(norm(L[k]),norm(R[perm[k]])) for k in range(len(L))]
    pairs.sort(key=lambda p: size(p[0])+size(p[1]))  # smaller pair on top
    off=max(width(b) for a,b in pairs)+1
